boundaries: AAI-01 must reverify current provider APIs, terms, licenses and entitlement capabilities before implementation
audio intent and provider asset identity remain separate
commercial provider audio is controlled or referenced rather than copied unless explicit license permits ingestion
unsupported provider capabilities remain unsupported rather than being emulated by scraping or prohibited copying
audio never becomes canonical World/Event/Combat truth
missing or disabled audio never blocks play
GM/player permissions and hidden cue metadata remain scoped
recording, streaming, caching, export and attribution behavior are explicit provider/license capabilities
AAI follows MAI-10 and precedes WCI-01
AAI has no implementation authority until explicitly selected
